wrong_claims: Section 6: 'Users with View All Data (for example System Administrator) see the fields regardless.' View All Data does not override FLS; FieldPermissions on Review__c.Rating__c/Status__c show no profile rows, so a System Administrator without one of the five permission sets would see those columns hidden.

defects.defect: States that View All Data users see the column fields regardless of FLS; wrong platform behavior presented as fact, which hides a real gap (no profile grants Read on the four column fields).
defects.skill_gap: v28 reference/org-verification.md FieldPermissions note says Modify All Data / View All Data users still see the field (wrong; corrected in v29.1). The skill caused this defect.

defects.defect: Says a user without Read FLS 'sees that column empty'; the platform omits columns the user cannot read. Minor inaccuracy in the security section.
